**Finding: compliant (LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).**

- No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee exists anywhere in the Agreement. Targeted searches ("liquidated damages", "penalty", "termination fee", "shortfall", "minimum fee") and a full review of the fee, term, termination, effect-of-termination, liability, audit, and force-majeure provisions found nothing responsive.
- The bargain is affirmatively favourable: § 9.4 (Customer convenience termination — Fees only for conforming Services through the termination date, plus refund of prepaid Fees), § 27.3 (force-majeure termination "without penalty"), and § 7.1 (no unstated minimum-use or similar charge).
- The § 2.1 take-or-pay minimum commitment is a volume commitment, not a liquidated damages or penalty mechanic; it belongs to the minimum-commitment rule and is not flagged twice here.
- Result sits at the **preferred** position, so no redline was proposed.
